## Checklist (see the wildbionics-contribute skill)

- [ ] I used the matching WildBionics skill(s): article · translate · figures · graph · design
- [ ] Every new fact has a verifiable source (DOI resolved via Crossref/PubMed); numbers recomputed
- [ ] English first, German translation with the glossary terms (`_data/glossary.yml`)
- [ ] Figures rendered on desktop and phone (EN + DE) and pass the figures checklist
- [ ] Local gates pass: `check_terms.rb`, `check_content.rb`, `check_plugin.rb`, `jekyll build` + `check_site.py`
- [ ] Self-review with `wildbionics-review` – no open must-fix items
- [ ] If a convention changed: skills updated and plugin version bumped
